title: AI generates property images for design discussions
summary: DIY Render’s EDIT generates and revises property images for design discussions; faster sales and measured time savings remain unverified.
source_collection: University of Texas AI Opportunity Inventory
account: 3D Architectural Solutions offers EDIT by DIY Render to generate and revise images of interiors, exteriors, and design plans. Its product page shows examples and describes uses in renovation discussions and property visualization. The company’s terms identify Google Gemini and Replicate services and warn that outputs can be inaccurate. The company acknowledges that precise refinements can be difficult. The reviewed external material supports the offered capability, but contains no product-specific evaluation of time savings, sales conversion, or sale prices.
purpose: The product is intended to help users create and revise conceptual property images for planning and communication.
developer: 3D Architectural Solutions; Google; model providers accessed through Replicate
taxonomy_note: Reduced task time is an intended benefit. Improved sales and accurate architectural renderings are not established.

ratings.reason: The reviewed sources do not establish the magnitude of the benefit.

ai_role.statement: Generative models edit or generate images from prompts and reference material. The reviewed sources do not measure the resulting improvement in decisions or transactions.
